title: Long Beach, Ulsan, KIA and LG reach Ulsan Fall League semifinals
text:
Long Beach, Ulsan, KIA, LG advance to Ulsan Fall League semifinals - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 29일(목) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Sports Long Beach, Ulsan, KIA, LG advance to Ulsan Fall League semifinals 
 입력 2026.10.29. 11:11 업데이트   2026.10.29. 11:50 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 The 2026 Ulsan-KBO Fall League, which completed all preliminary schedules, confirmed the teams advancing to the semifinals.
 The 2026 Ulsan-KBO Fall League, organized by the Korea Baseball Organization (KBO) and sponsored by Ulsan Metropolitan City and the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, completed its preliminary schedule on the 28th, with the Long Beach Coast (USA), Ulsan Wales, KIA Tigers and LG Twins advancing to the semifinals.
 The semifinals will be held on the 30th at Ulsan Munsu Baseball Stadium. At 12 p.m., top-seeded Long Beach will face fourth-seeded LG, and at 6 p.m., second-seeded Ulsan will face third-seeded KIA to compete for spots in the final. The winners of the two games will meet for the championship at 2 p.m. on the 31st at the same venue.
 Long Beach, participating in the tournament for the first time this year, finished the preliminaries with an 8-0-2 record and a perfect winning percentage of 1.000, remaining unbeaten to claim first place. In particular, a solid pitching staff that posted a team ERA in the 1.00s (1.50) led the unbeaten run. Long Beach, which belongs to the Pioneer Baseball League, an MLB partner league, is the only overseas team to reach the semifinals and will challenge fourth-seeded LG for a spot in the final.
 Ulsan, participating in the KBO Futures League for the first time this year, advanced to the championship series as the top team in the southern league and also secured second place in this tournament's preliminaries with a 5-1-2 record. Backed by home fans, Ulsan will challenge third-seeded KIA for a place in the final.
 With fierce ranking competition so intense that five KBO teams were tied at a .500 winning percentage before the final day of the preliminaries, the remaining two semifinal tickets went to KIA and LG. KIA secured third place with a thrilling come-from-behind win against Samsung, and LG rose to fourth after a 6-0 victory in the final game against a selected team from the Japanese independent league.
 Meanwhile, the semifinals and final held at Ulsan Munsu Baseball Stadium will be broadcast live on KBSN SPORTS (semifinal game 1), KBS LIFE (semifinal game 2 and the final) and the KBO's official YouTube channel.
